about: The models the demo router reasons about. Prices, context length and per-topic capability are read live from the Benchmark Heaven API through bench_id; cache hit rates are our own measurements (EXPERIMENTS.md section 2). Which endpoint actually serves a model, and under which account, is supplied at runtime through DEMO_ROUTES_JSON and never stored here.

demo.label: Bonsai 2 27B
demo.note: A ternary 27B model running on WebGPU in volunteers' browsers. Free, slow, best effort.
demo.capability_basis: Hand-set from the published model card and our own browser evaluation, not from a benchmark feed. Treated as weak evidence.
